journal: Journal of Thermal Analysis and Calorimetry
composition: PAN copolymerized from acrylonitrile, methyl acrylate and sodium p-styrene sulfonate; fractions not reported
treatment_method: Wet spun from DMSO; heat-stretched and heat-set160C; water wash; vacuum dry70C overnight

conditions_locator: Measurements and characterizations pp720-721: standalone TG paragraph N2/10Cmin/100-700C; separate LOI braided-fiber method
pairing_evidence: Preparation defines A/B series and amination-time suffixes. Both TG and LOI test the resulting spun fibers after preparation rinsing; TG uses powdered aliquots and LOI braided fibers, not unspun bulk PAN. Figure5 labels and Thermal stability exact R700 lists match the ordered sample series. No durability wash is studied.
source_location: pp720-721 methods; p723 Figure5 and measured control LOI; pp725-726 exact residue series and Figure8
limitations: R700 is the measured total residue, with no inferred Zn subtraction. Near320C/420C DTG prose is approximate and omitted. Figure11 temperatures are DSC and excluded.
